problem_restatement: V58 has no executable BTC bullish-continuation route. Test whether options-implied risk compensation adds information to an otherwise ordinary bullish breakout without reopening a rejected price-only or Hulk-side inversion.
hypothesis: A BTC breakout that begins while Deribit 30-day implied variance is unusually high relative to trailing realized variance may earn positive continuation returns because the market is compensating holders for bearing priced uncertainty. The price structure supplies direction because DVOL alone is not directional.

source_contract.timestamp_interpretation: Each DVOL timestamp is conservatively treated as an hour-open label and its OHLC is unavailable until timestamp plus one hour.
source_contract.revision_handling: The official historical endpoint does not expose bitemporal revision metadata. Freeze raw pages and retrieval identity; any later source difference requires a new source revision rather than overwriting this experiment.
source_contract.methodology: DVOL is a smoothed 30-day annualized implied volatility index built from Deribit BTC options around the 30-day maturity using variance-swap methodology.

control_contracts.price_only_bullish_breakout_long: Same bullish structure, strategic exits, protection, sizing, and costs without the high-VRP condition.
control_contracts.high_vrp_only_long: Same high-VRP onset, strategic exits, protection, sizing, and costs without bullish price structure.
control_contracts.low_vrp_bullish_breakout_long_placebo: Same bullish structure during the causal lower-quartile VRP state, with identical exits and economics.
control_contracts.v58_liquidity_sweep_long_control: Unchanged V58 hourly sweep-reclaim entry with its own 60-bps stop, 60-bps target, and 24-hour fallback.

prior_search_disclosure.materially_distinct_input: Deribit options-implied volatility joined to trailing Hyperliquid realized volatility.

known_uncertainties_and_failure_modes: DVOL is an action gauge and often reflects upside as well as downside demand; it has no intrinsic long direction.

The official historical endpoint exposes event timestamps but no historical knowledge-time or revision ledger; the one-hour availability convention is conservative but unverified against archived receipt times.
Cross-venue Deribit-to-Hyperliquid latency and temporary dislocations are not represented by hourly DVOL candles.
The 30-day implied-versus-trailing-realized spread is a proxy, not a directly tradable variance swap premium.
Rolling quantiles are causal but can drift and may create unstable cadence in regime transitions.
All BTC price partitions have already informed prior research, materially increasing multiple-testing risk.
A one-year window may be too short for a slow options-risk-premium mechanism to produce an adequate effective sample.
Bar replay cannot prove exact BBO ordering, market impact, or live receipt latency.
falsifiers: Reject the exact candidate if either out-of-development partition has fewer than ten completed nominal trades.
Reject the exact candidate if any validation or pseudo-holdout scenario has nonpositive net PnL, PF at or below one, nonpositive net excluding the largest winner, liquidation, or insolvency.
Reject the exact candidate if it fails to beat no action, price-only, or unchanged V58 sweep net PnL in either nominal out-of-development partition.

Invalidate the experiment if source or generator hashes drift, hourly coverage is incomplete, a current observation enters its own rolling threshold, or signal execution precedes conservative availability.
A failed exact candidate cannot be rescued by changing the VRP quantile, lookbacks, breakout length, stop, target, maximum hold, or delay on these opened partitions.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Acquire and checksum the official hourly DVOL source exactly once, validate point-in-time continuity without inspecting candidate outcomes, then execute this frozen falsification experiment.
